d: Should you lift heavy or light? You have to train with heavy weights for the best muscle growth; at least, that’s what many people say. But not everyone agrees. Light weights vs heavy weights for growth is one of the most debated questions in fitness. So, I’m putting lifting heavy vs lifting light to the test MYSELF. For 60 days straight, I’ll split my body in half. One side with heavy weights, the other with light weights.
